evidences.evidence_quote: RF-based schemes focus on using high-frequency signals to characterize vibrations induced by the loudspeaker. These schemes mainly utilize millimeter waves [8], [9], [10], [45], [46], [47], [48], [49], RFID signals [11], [12], [13], ...
evidences.evidence_context: These schemes mainly utilize millimeter waves [8], [9], [10], [45], [46], [47], [48], [49], RFID signals [11], [12], [13], electromagnetic signals [15], [16], [17], [18], and WiFi signals [14], among other RF signals [50].
